ev_0004.summary: Full circle centered at O(185.58,222.22), radius 157.27 px. Points A, B, C, D lie on the circle (radial distances 157.45, 157.48, 157.30, 157.27 px). Letters A, B, C, D, O are supplied by the supervisor as verified. D and C are diametrically opposite (midpoint of DC is (185.46,222.13), about O), so DC is a diameter through O. Segments AB, AC and BC are drawn; BC is horizontal at y~359. AB and AC are of nearly equal length (304.3 vs 304.0 px), which suggests isosceles ABC, but this is not claimed as a verified relation. No right-angle marks were verified, so none are reported. Endpoint overshoots of 4-7 px on AB, AC and DC are detector noise and are snapped to the labelled vertices. The horizontal stroke seg_04 extends about 12-13 px beyond B and C, which is more than the snap threshold, so it is left unresolved rather than snapped.
